name: Landhaus Pichler
beschreibung: The Gasthof Landhaus Pichler has a quiet location in the Tannheimer Tal in Tirol. The alpine surroundings are characterized by mountain meadows and are developed for hiking and winter sports. The Gasthof's amenities include comfortable rooms with balconies as well as a wellness area. The family-like atmosphere is shaped by traditional Tiroler hospitality. The restaurant offers regional dishes from local cuisine. The target group consists mainly of those seeking relaxation and active holidaymakers.
